content.value: . Make sentences with the following structures using the words given in brackets.
(i) Subject + Intransitive verb + Adverb. (Live as verb)
(ii) Subject + Transitive verb + Object. (Write as verb)
(iii) Subject + Linking verb + Adjective Complement. (Seem as verb)
(iv) That + Subject + Verb + Adverb of Manner + Verb + Adjective complement. (Read and is as verb)
(v) Subject + Verb + Adverb of Manner + that + Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb. (Study and do as verb)
(vi) Subject + Relative pronoun + Verb + Adverb +Verb + Noun complement. (Work and is as verb)
(vii) Subject + Linking verb + not only + Adjective complement + but also + adjective complement. (Is as verb)
